scorecards.inningsCommentary: South Africa commenced their first innings at The Wanderers Stadium, aiming to set an imposing baseline total. The centerpiece of the innings was a brilliant 152 from AK Markram, complemented by a commanding 105-run stand between Abraham Villiers and AK Markram that absorbed bowling hostility and accelerated the scoring rate to 3.56 RPO. Australia's bowling response was spearheaded by Pat Cummins (5/78), who generated sustained pressure and triggered critical breakthroughs to prevent runaway scoring. Finishing at 488/10 (136.5 ov), South Africa established an overwhelming first-innings foundation that firmly dictated the terms of the match.

scorecards.inningsCommentary: Australia embarked on a high-stakes fourth-innings chase of 612 Runs, confronting a deteriorating pitch and aggressive field settings. JA Burns anchored the innings with a resolute 42, providing backbone against a probing bowling attack while middle-order partnerships consolidated the position. South Africa's bowling response was spearheaded by VD Philander (6/20), who generated sustained pressure and triggered critical breakthroughs to prevent runaway scoring. Dismissed for 119/10 (46.4 ov), Australia succumbed to fourth-innings pressure as South Africa's bowlers closed out the victory.

VD Philander spearheaded South Africa's attack to bowl out Australia for 119 and seal victory.

summaryTab.matchCommentary:
The Test match at The Wanderers Stadium commenced with high tactical intensity as South Africa posted 488/10 (136.5 ov) in their opening innings. In response, Australia countered with 221/10 (69.6 ov), setting the stage for a compelling contest of tactical endurance. Early sessions tested batting resolve against disciplined seam movement, with both attacks striving to gain the upper hand on a developing surface.

The defining turning point arrived during 6-Wicket Spell: VD Philander (6/20), which irrevocably altered the trajectory of the match. As the match progressed through its pivotal middle stages, Pat Cummins delivered a masterclass for Australia (51 Runs & 9 Wkts), absorbing intense pressure and tilting the momentum decisively. Crucial partnership stands and incisive bowling spells broke the opposition's resistance, shifting the control share (South Africa 59%) and allowing South Africa to dictate terms heading into the decisive sessions.

Entering the final innings, Australia faced an uphill battle under unrelenting scoreboard pressure. South Africa's bowling unit, bolstered by AK Markram (189 Runs), maintained relentless discipline and attacked the stumps relentlessly. Wicket clusters in the closing sessions dismantled any remaining resistance, sealing South Africa won by 492 runs in comprehensive fashion.

Verdict: South Africa's triumph was built on superior pressure absorption, clinical execution during critical moments, and the ability to dominate key sessions. While Australia produced fighting phases, South Africa won the pivotal turning points and sustained higher tactical control across all five days to emerge as deserved victors.
